lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dhe kooR muthee kooRiaar ||
lines.translation: O woman, the false ones are being cheated by falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir prabh saachaa sohanaa paaeeai gur beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God is your Husband; He is Handsome and True. He is obtained by reflecting upon the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਉ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh ka(n)t na pachhaanaee tin kiu rain vihaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize their Husband Lord; how will they spend their life-night?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬਿ ਅਟੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: garab ateeaa trisanaa jalahi dukh paavahi doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: Filled with arrogance, they burn with desire; they suffer in the pain of the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rateeaa sohaaganee tin vichahu haumai jaai ||
lines.translation: The happy soul-brides are attuned to the Shabad; their egotism is eliminated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa pir raavahi aapanaa tinaa sukhe sukh vihaai ||2||
lines.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord forever, and their life-night passes in the most blissful peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਪਿਰ ਮੁਤੀਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan vihoonee pir muteeaa piram na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: She is utterly lacking in spiritual wisdom; she is abandoned by her Husband Lord. She cannot obtain His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan matee a(n)dher hai bin pir dekhe bhukh na jaai ||
lines.translation: In the darkness of intellectual ignorance, she cannot see her Husband, and her hunger does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho mai pir dehu milaai ||
lines.translation: Come and meet with me, my sister soul-brides, and unite me with my Husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur milai pir paaiaa sach samaai ||3||
lines.translation: She who meets the True Guru, by perfect good fortune, finds her Husband; she is absorbed in the True One. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se saheeaa sohaaganee jin kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: Those upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace become His happy soul-brides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasam pachhaanahi aapanaa tan man aagai dei ||
lines.translation: One who recognizes her Lord and Master places her body and mind in offering before Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar var paaiaa aapanaa haumai door karei ||
lines.translation: Within her own home, she finds her Husband Lord; her egotism is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੬੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sobhaava(n)teeaa sohaaganee anadin bhagat karei ||4||28||61||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the happy soul-brides are embellished and exalted; night and day they are absorbed in devotional worship. ||4||28||61||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik pir raavahi aapanaa hau kai dar poochhau jaai ||
lines.translation: Some enjoy their Husband Lord; unto whose door should I go to ask for Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevee bhaau kar mai pir dehu milaai ||
lines.translation: I serve my True Guru with love, that He may lead me to Union with my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh upaae aape vekhai kis neRai kis door ||
lines.translation: He created all, and He Himself watches over us. Some are close to Him, and some are far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin pir sa(n)ge jaaniaa pir raave sadaa hadoor ||1||
lines.translation: She who knows her Husband Lord to be always with her, enjoys His Constant Presence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਤੂ ਚਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dhe too chal gur kai bhaai ||
lines.translation: O woman, you must walk in harmony with the Guru's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin raavahi pir aapanaa sahaje sach samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, you shall enjoy your Husband, and you shall intuitively merge into the True One. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rateeaa sohaaganee sachai sabad seegaar ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Shabad, the happy soul-brides are adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har var paain ghar aapanai gur kai het piaar ||
lines.translation: Within their own home, they obtain the Lord as their Husband, with love for the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sej suhaavee har ra(n)g ravai bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: Upon her beautiful and cozy bed, she enjoys the Love of her Lord. She is overflowing with the treasure of devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh preetam man vasai j sabhasai dei adhaar ||2||
lines.translation: That Beloved God abides in her mind; He gives His Support to all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir saalaahan aapanaa tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to those who praise their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਈ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan arapee sir deee tin kai laagaa paai ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind and body to them, and give my head as well; I fall at their feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee ik pachhaaniaa doojaa bhaau chukaai ||
lines.translation: Those who recognize the One renounce the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam pachhaaneeai naanak sach samaai ||3||29||62||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh recognizes the Naam, O Nanak, and is absorbed into the True One. ||3||29||62||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਚੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee sachaa sach too sabh kichh terai cheerai ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. All things are in Your Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਫਿਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਪੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh tarasade phire bin gur bhete peerai ||
lines.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings wander around searching for You, but without the Guru, they do not find You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸੂਖ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੀਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu bakhase bakhas lae sookh sadaa sareerai ||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Forgiveness, this human body finds lasting peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee sev karee sach gahir ga(n)bheerai ||1||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I serve the True One, who is Immeasurably Deep and Profound. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere naam rate sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: O my mind, attuned to the Naam, you shall find peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee naam salaaheeai doojaa avar na koi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and praise the Naam; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai no hukam hai bahi sachaa dharam beechaar ||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, by the Hukam of God's Command, sits and administers True Justice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਆਤਮਾ ਓਹੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai dusat aatamaa ohu teree sarakaar ||
lines.translation: Those evil souls, ensnared by the love of duality, are subject to Your Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: adhiaatamee har gun taas man japahi ek muraar ||
lines.translation: The souls on their spiritual journey chant and meditate within their minds on the One Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.
